architecture_overview.description: The Claude Agent Repository is a multi-agent AI coordination platform where teams of AI agents collaborate on research, coding, analysis, and data gathering tasks. It uses a file-based architecture with JSON/JSONL for communication and SQLite for shared state.

directory_structure.knowledge-base/: Shared knowledge entries in Markdown with YAML frontmatter. 24 entries (KB-0001 through KB-0025, excluding KB-0011). Index at knowledge-base/index.json.
directory_structure.teams/: Team session logs documenting what each team accomplished. 22 sessions logged. Template at teams/TEAM_LOG_TEMPLATE.md.
directory_structure.storage/scripts/: 28 reusable scripts (25 Python, 3 Go). Index at storage/scripts/index.json. Includes data-gathering methods, validation tools, search tools, and Go compiled binaries.
directory_structure.storage/api-tools/: API tool definitions. Currently 1 tool (Sonnet Research API). Index at storage/api-tools/index.json.
directory_structure.storage/sources/: 35 curated data sources across 7 categories (financial, news, scientific, government, geospatial, social-media, general). Index at storage/sources/index.json.
directory_structure.storage/coordination/: Multi-agent coordination infrastructure including JSONL message bus, SQLite shared state, coordination modules, tests, stress tests, SOPs, and team outputs.
directory_structure.market-research/: Stock picking methods and performance tracking. Contains AI quant techniques index with 8 categories and 221 techniques. No active picks yet.

key_design_principles: Every AI team builds on the knowledge of the last team (Prime Directive)
Flat JSON indexes scale to ~1000 entries before needing migration to SQLite
Proto A (JSONL + SQLite WAL) is the production communication system
All teams launch simultaneously unless a hard data dependency exists (SOP-011)
BEGIN IMMEDIATE is the universal concurrency primitive for SQLite coordination
Bus messages must stay under 4096 bytes for POSIX atomic write guarantees

coordination_system.overview: The coordination system enables multiple AI agent processes to communicate and share state in real-time. It uses two layers: a JSONL append-only message bus for ephemeral communication and a SQLite WAL database for persistent shared state.

communication_layer.technology: JSONL append-only files with POSIX O_APPEND atomic writes
communication_layer.message_limit: 4096 bytes per message (POSIX atomic write guarantee on Linux)

channels.topic-{name}.jsonl: Multi-team discussion channels on specific topics

state_layer.technology: SQLite in WAL mode with BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions
state_layer.concurrency: Multiple readers + single writer. Writers never block readers. SQLITE_BUSY handled with retry_on_busy decorator (exponential backoff, 5 retries, busy_timeout=30000ms).
key_tables: rate_limits / rate_limit_config - API rate limiting coordination
think_tank - Think tank proposals and convergence
work_items - Work tracking for help protocol
scratchpad - Namespaced key-value store with TTL

help_protocol.py.purpose: Manages team help requests, idle detection, and automatic work assignment

direct_channels.py.purpose: Named channels (direct/topic/broadcast), presence tracking, progress broadcasting with bottleneck detection

work_stealing.py.purpose: Shared work queue with atomic steal, DAG pipeline management, namespaced key-value store with TTL

coordinator_hub.py.purpose: Hub-and-spoke architecture for real-time agent monitoring with status reporting and coordinator instructions

bus_cli.py.purpose: CLI wrapper for all Proto A bus operations. Decouples agents from Python import paths.

multi_team_runner.py.purpose: Production multi-team launcher with config file support

think_tank.py.purpose: Cross-team findings convergence engine. Deduplicates findings, categorizes, and generates roadmaps.

dashboard.py.purpose: Real-time system status dashboard showing agents, bus activity, and findings

hub_and_spoke.description: Added by TEAM-0025. A coordinator-mediated architecture where agents report status to a central hub and receive instructions. Agents cannot see each other directly -- the coordinator mediates all cross-agent communication.
hub_and_spoke.implementation: coordinator_hub.py with AgentReporter and CoordinatorDashboard classes

prototype_systems.overview: Two competing prototypes were built and tested for inter-agent communication. Proto A was selected for production; Proto B was archived.

proto_a.name: JSONL + SQLite WAL
proto_a.architecture: JSONL append-only files for message bus + SQLite WAL for shared state
strengths: More correct out-of-the-box (0 new bugs in deep stress testing)
BEGIN IMMEDIATE provides robust transaction isolation
16.7% more data points collected vs baseline
proto_a.test_results: 113/113 tests passed + 96/96 stress tests + 36 benchmark runs
proto_a.known_bugs: 41 bugs identified by TEAM-0025 think tanks across help_protocol (14), direct_channels (14), work_stealing (13). 8 critical. Fix proposals documented.

proto_b.name: Named pipes (FIFOs) + mmap
proto_b.architecture: Named pipes with spillover files for messaging + mmap'd fixed-size structs for shared state
limitations: 7 integration bugs found (vs 3 for Proto A)
proto_b.archival_reason: Proto A more correct, better tested, simpler, more extensible. Proto B reserved for future 50+ agent optimization if needed.

data_gathering.overview: A suite of 13 data gathering methods (SCR-0006 through SCR-0028) that collect information from diverse sources. Built through 2 iterations with benchmarking.

method_websearch.py.description: Multi-query web search with 3-5 query variants and URL deduplication

method_wikipedia.py.description: Deep extraction with summaries, sections, references, categories, See Also links

method_arxiv.py.description: Academic paper search with Atom XML parsing
method_arxiv.py.status: functional (fixed HTTPS, error handling in iteration 2)

method_hybrid.py.description: Combines all sources with parallel execution, TF-IDF dedup, credibility weighting, corroboration scoring

method_iterative.py.description: 3 rounds of progressively deeper queries, each refining based on previous results

method_openalex.py.description: Academic search with citation metadata, DOIs, open access status. Best free academic API.

method_hackernews.py.description: Tech news search with points, comments, deduplication across both sources

method_guardian.py.description: News search with headlines, body text, sections. DuckDuckGo fallback.

method_semantic_scholar.py.description: Paper search with TLDRs, citation counts, fields of study, open access PDFs. 1 req/sec.

method_wikidata.py.description: Entity search with labels, descriptions, properties, Wikipedia sitelinks

method_github.py.description: Repository and code search with stars, languages, topics, licenses

ddg_utils.py.purpose: Shared DuckDuckGo search utilities with rate limiting (0.5s between requests)

request_cache.py.purpose: File-based HTTP response cache with SHA-256 keys, base64 storage, configurable TTL (default 1 hour)

benchmark_runner.py.purpose: Benchmark harness for all data gathering methods. Times execution and calculates quality scores.
benchmark_runner.py.usage: python benchmark_runner.py (runs all methods against test query)

validate-storage.py.purpose: Comprehensive 10-check validation suite for the storage system
validate-storage.py.args: No arguments. Runs all checks and prints report.
validate-storage.py.notes: Currently reports 322 errors due to missing optional fields in sources and api-tools entries. These are field completeness issues, not corruption.

test-edge-cases.py.purpose: 35-test edge case and boundary testing suite

repair-storage.py.purpose: Automated repair for common storage issues
repair-storage.py.notes: WARNING: Without --dry-run, modifies files immediately. Always use --dry-run first.

kb_validator.py.purpose: Validates KB entries and index.json consistency

index_rebuilder.py.notes: --dry-run is the default. Use --fix to actually write changes.

cross_ref_checker.py.purpose: Validates all cross-references, detects cycles, finds orphans
cross_ref_checker.py.notes: Prints dependency tree and structured report. No arguments needed.

fast_validate.notes: 143x faster than Python equivalent. Good for pre-commit hooks.

kb_search.py.purpose: Full-text TF-IDF search across KB entries, team logs, and scripts
kb_search.py.usage: python3 storage/scripts/kb_search.py <query> [--tags TAGS] [--category CAT] [--type kb,team,script] [--top N] [--json]

search-storage.py.usage: python3 storage/scripts/search-storage.py -k KEYWORD [-c CATEGORY] [-t TEAM] [--after DATE] [--before DATE] [-d DATA_TYPE] [-s {scripts,tools,sources}] [--demo]

fast_search.purpose: High-speed Go full-text search with inverted index (3.5ms)
fast_search.notes: 28x faster than Python kb_search.py. Recommended for interactive use.

grade_research.py.purpose: Evaluates research JSON quality across 5 dimensions

merge_research.py.purpose: Merges multiple team research JSON files with deduplication

handoff_tracker.py.purpose: Extracts and tracks action items from team session logs
handoff_tracker.py.notes: Run at start of each new team session to see what is still open. ~30% of recommendations are never addressed.

staleness_detector.py.purpose: 6-check repository health scoring (stale statuses, regressions, broken refs, etc.)

fast_cache.purpose: High-speed Go file-based key-value cache with TTL

sop_reference.overview: 13 SOPs exist covering all coordination tools and operational procedures. SOPs are stored in storage/coordination/sops/ as JSON files.

SOP-009.title: KB Validation and Maintenance Operating Procedure

SOP-010.title: New Team Onboarding
SOP-010.description: 11-step guide for new AI teams joining the system

SOP-011.title: Central Commander Launch Protocol
SOP-011.description: Ensures coordinator maximizes parallelism. ALL teams launch simultaneously unless hard data dependency. Includes Hard Dependency Test, 10 Anti-Sequential Rules, decision trees.

SOP-012.title: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention Protocol
SOP-012.description: 5-checkpoint polling strategy, 7 intervention triggers with severity ratings, 6 intervention actions with escalation path, completion handling procedures.

SOP-013.title: Agent Prompt Engineering and Context Distribution
SOP-013.description: 6-part canonical prompt template, context distribution rules, pre-built templates for 5 agent types, 12-point QA checklist, 8 common mistakes documented.

efficiency_guide.json.description: 9 efficiency patterns and anti-patterns for multi-team coordination

future_team_data_strategy.json.description: Data storage strategy and knowledge transfer protocol. Defines 9 data categories with what/where/format/retention/naming/indexing for each.

testing_guide.overview: The system has 289+ tests across unit tests, stress tests, and benchmarks.

coordination_stress_tests.covers: Concurrent offers, volume limits, race conditions, unicode, zombies, thundering herd, pipeline DAGs, scratchpad TTL, channel name safety, message boundaries

prototype_tests.total: 113 tests (28 regression + 23 deep stress + 62 Proto B functional)

pre_commit_checklist: Run pytest on coordination tests (2.8s for unit tests)

launching_multi_team_operation.step_1: Read CLAUDE.md and recent team session logs
launching_multi_team_operation.step_2: Read SOP-010 (New Team Onboarding) and SOP-011 (Central Commander Launch Protocol)
launching_multi_team_operation.step_3: Run handoff_tracker.py --unresolved-only to see open action items
launching_multi_team_operation.step_4: Decompose the task into parallel work units using the Hard Dependency Test from SOP-011
launching_multi_team_operation.step_5: Assign team types (think tank, coding, research, SOP) using SOP-013 prompt templates
launching_multi_team_operation.step_6: Initialize coordination: python bus_cli.py init storage/coordination/db/state.db
launching_multi_team_operation.step_7: Launch ALL teams simultaneously in a single message (SOP-011 core principle)
launching_multi_team_operation.step_8: Monitor using SOP-012: 5 checkpoints (post-launch, early, mid, completion, final)
launching_multi_team_operation.step_10: Create KB entries for validated insights, team session log, update indexes

optimal_team_configurations.research: 3 leads + 2 subs each = 9 agents (Config 3, best efficiency ratio from KB-0007)
optimal_team_configurations.recommended_total: 5-7 teams, 18-20 agents total for complex operations

key_operational_patterns: Use bus_cli.py for all inter-agent communication (CLI-first, EFF-006)
Register capabilities on startup for auto-assignment (EFF-007)
Post findings incrementally, not at end (EFF-008)
Use Scratchpad for large intermediate data, bus for notifications (EFF-004)
Update progress after each significant step for bottleneck detection (EFF-005)
Use PipelineManager for DAG dependencies instead of manual coordination (EFF-003)
post_operation_checklist: Run think_tank.py to generate convergence report
Create KB entry for significant findings (use knowledge-base/TEMPLATE.md)
Update knowledge-base/index.json with new KB entry
Run kb_validator.py and cross_ref_checker.py to verify consistency
Run index_rebuilder.py --fix if indexes are out of sync
Register any new scripts in storage/scripts/index.json

new_sop_recommendations.title: Coordinator Hub Operating Procedure
new_sop_recommendations.description: Step-by-step guide for using coordinator_hub.py's AgentReporter and CoordinatorDashboard classes. Covers agent registration, status reporting, polling for instructions, and coordinator monitoring/intervention patterns.

new_sop_recommendations.title: Failure Recovery Runbook
new_sop_recommendations.description: Operational procedures for recovering from the 26 failure modes identified in KB-0017. Covers SQLITE_BUSY cascades, coordinator crashes, bus file corruption, split-brain scenarios, and resource exhaustion. Step-by-step recovery for each failure mode.

new_sop_recommendations.title: Index Maintenance and Cleanup SOP
new_sop_recommendations.description: Procedures for keeping all index.json files in sync, registering orphan scripts, cleaning up stress test artifacts, and running the full validation pipeline (validate-storage.py, kb_validator.py, cross_ref_checker.py, fast_validate).

new_sop_recommendations.title: Data Gathering Operations SOP
new_sop_recommendations.description: End-to-end guide for conducting data gathering operations: selecting methods, configuring caching, running benchmarks, handling API failures, and archiving results. Covers all 11 data gathering methods with decision tree for method selection.

new_sop_recommendations.title: Market Research Operations SOP
new_sop_recommendations.description: Guide for conducting market research using the system. Covers technique selection from the 8 categories, pick logging using market-research/picks/TEMPLATE.md, performance tracking, and integration with the Sonnet Research API.

new_sop_recommendations.title: Environment Setup and Fresh Deployment SOP
new_sop_recommendations.description: Step-by-step guide for setting up a fresh Claude Agent Repository environment from scratch. Covers prerequisites (Python 3.11+, Go), directory initialization, coordination system setup, Go binary compilation, and verification checklist.

new_sop_recommendations.title: Bug Fix Workflow SOP
new_sop_recommendations.description: Standard procedure for addressing the 41 identified bugs across help_protocol.py, direct_channels.py, and work_stealing.py. Covers prioritization (critical first), testing requirements, regression prevention, and documentation updates.
